query: Rename the Contract content type to Agreement. Show me the plan first.
expected_behavior: Runs or hands over scripts/spo-update-content-type.ps1 with -PlanPath and without -Execute, as a dry run
States the dry run prints a structured JSON action plan and makes zero tenant writes
Does not supply a confirmation token until the user asks for the real run

query: The plan looks right. Apply it for real.
expected_behavior: Adds -Execute and -ConfirmToken UPDATE-SPO-CONTENT-TYPES to the same command
Treats the real run as a live tenant write that the user runs, not something to run unprompted
Does not alter the plan content between the dry run and the real run

query: Change which columns the content type contains.
expected_behavior: Limits itself to name, description, group and hidden properties
Says adding or removing field links is not what this skill does and points to the content-type creation skill
Makes no change without -Execute and the token
